description: Source code for application management in an AUTOSAR-based Arctic Core platform, including functions for application ID retrieval, access control, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: GetApplicationID
methods.description: Returns the ID of the currently running OS-Application.

methods.name: CallTrustedFunction
methods.description: Calls a trusted function within the OS-Application context.

methods.name: CheckISRMemoryAccess
methods.description: Checks memory access rights for an ISR.

methods.name: CheckTaskMemoryAccess
methods.description: Checks memory access rights for a task.

methods.name: CheckObjectAccess
methods.description: Verifies if an OS-Application has access to a specific object.

methods.name: CheckObjectOwnership
methods.description: Determines which OS-Application owns a specific object.

methods.name: AllowAccess
methods.description: Sets the calling application state to accessible after restart.

methods.name: GetApplicationState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of an OS-Application.

methods.name: Os_ApplStart
methods.description: Starts all applications and calls their startup hooks.
